verification.subject: Confirm your email for Argent
verification.intro: Hi. To finish creating your Argent account, confirm your email address.
verification.expiry: The link expires in 24 hours and works only once.
verification.ignore: If you did not create an Argent account, ignore this message.

password_reset.subject: Reset your Argent password
password_reset.intro: Hi. We received a request to reset the password of your Argent account.
password_reset.expiry: The link expires in 60 minutes and works only once.
password_reset.ignore: If you did not ask for it, ignore this message: your password stays the same.
